title: RDR2 DLSS / Frame Generation Mouse Bug: Mouse stops working in-game while keyboard functions normally
summary: Hey everyone, I’m running into a frustrating issue in Red Dead Redemption 2. Whenever I go into the settings and enable DLSS and Frame Generation, my mouse completely stops working once I'm in-game. My keyboard works fine (I can use menus, shortcuts, and movement keys), but the mouse cursor won't respond or look around at all. Has anyone else experienced this specific bug when turning on Frame Generation / DLSS in RDR2? If so, is there a known fix or workaround for it?
